name: @flower/safe-logging
description: Pure, dependency-free secure error serialization and log-message sanitization shared by every backend runtime (api, worker, scheduler, realtime) and the Prisma client factory. Allowlist-first: an error is reduced to type / code / SQLSTATE / operation / safe message template / stack-frame locations; raw messages, stack headers, metadata and causes are never emitted. NO runtime dependencies, NO domain logic (CLAUDE.md rule 1, task 3b.11 S-1).
